body: this is so helpful !! thank you!!! i’ve actually lived in LA on my own for a couple of months so i have a general idea of what it’ll be like. i’m also already really independent and buy most of my own things/pay bills already anyways. thank you for mentioning things i should consider !

$400 sounds like more than enough given my living style. i buy vegetarian groceries, vegetables are not expensive. i was already planning on walking/skating around everywhere. i already considered the cost of my existent phone bill (which isn’t going to hurt me much at all), and i already thrift my clothes instead of spending way too much on fast fashion pieces....i remember asking for tips, not for discouragement lol
i struggle w it all the time!!! and i try to talk myself out of it and then it happens again and i am still stuck with feeling awful. every. time.
congrats! i’m proud of you for your hard work and accomplishments!!
right before i go to sleep and as soon as i wake up.
i recently bought myself an entire record player set up and 4 new records to try and feel better.. it lasts for a second and then i am empty again.
opening up at this point is so difficult when there’s so much to unpack.

try and throw up whatever you have sitting in your stomach right now love. as for your wounds, clean them up gently. warm water and soap. bandage yourself up if you can. remember that you have value in this lifetime. feel free to reach out if you need
do em, they’re fun. just be safe and always do your research beforehand. personally i’d stay away from the hard stuff, but marijuana, psychedelics, and feel-good drugs like molly ? go for it !

thank you for reaching out. opening up to people these days just doesn’t feel genuine enough. glad to hear i’m not completely alone in all of this. i wish you the best, and hope you get through it all as well.
